data.name: PublicVisibilityConfirmation

data.name: RecoveryFolderUnavailable
data.value: The recovery folder could not be opened. Your recovery data has not been removed.

data.name: ScanCompleteWithIssuesFormat
data.value: Scan completed with {0} shortcut(s) listed and {1} issue(s).

data.name: UnexpectedScanFailure
data.value: The scan could not be completed. No files were changed.

data.value: Desktop Guard could not update its sign-in setting. The saved preference was kept.

data.name: NotificationUnavailable
data.value: Windows notifications are unavailable. New shortcuts still appear in this list.

data.name: StateLoadFailure
data.value: Desktop Guard could not safely read its saved state. It has not replaced or reset that data.

data.name: StateTooLarge
data.value: Desktop Guard's saved state exceeds its safety limit. It has not replaced or reset that data.

data.name: StateUnavailable
data.value: Desktop Guard could not access its local state or recovery data. Check that the data folder is available.

data.name: InitializationFailure
data.value: Desktop Guard could not initialize safely. Shortcut management is disabled until the problem is resolved.

data.name: OperationFailure
data.value: The operation could not be completed. Desktop Guard did not delete or overwrite a file.

data.name: DestinationConflict
data.value: A file already exists at the destination. Both files were left unchanged.

data.name: DesktopShortcutAlreadyExists
data.value: A Desktop Guard shortcut already exists on the other desktop. DG did not create or restore another visible copy.

data.name: FileNotStable
data.value: The shortcut is still changing. It was left on the Desktop; try again after it settles.

data.name: SourceMissing
data.value: The shortcut could not be found at its expected location. No other file was changed.

data.name: AccessDenied
data.value: Desktop Guard could not access the shortcut or recovery folder. Check the folder permissions.

data.name: FileLocked
data.value: The shortcut is in use. Close the installer or app, then retry the operation. Desktop Guard did not retry automatically.

data.name: ElevationCancelled
data.value: The Windows permission request was cancelled. The operation was not completed.

data.name: ElevationFailed
data.value: Windows could not complete the requested shortcut operation with elevated permissions.

data.name: InvalidPath
data.value: The shortcut path failed a safety check. No file was changed.

data.name: RecoveryUnavailable
data.value: The recovery folder is unavailable. The shortcut was left unchanged.

data.name: AmbiguousRecovery
data.value: Desktop Guard found an unexpected file state. It left the files untouched for review.

data.name: IoFailure
data.value: Windows could not move the shortcut. The original and recovery data were preserved.
